title: Two-Guardrail OR Composition Evidence Receipt
assumptions: Rows are deterministic labeled examples for the v0 visual essay, not a random sample.
For guardrail decisions, 1 means block or flag and 0 means allow or miss.
The composed system blocks when A OR B blocks.
The bounded claim is class-conditional on harmful examples only.
No independence assumption is made between guardrails.
nonClaims: This is not a deployment certificate.
This does not prove the model is safe.
This does not assume guardrail independence.
This does not generalize beyond the stated dataset and assumptions.
This does not provide cryptographic provenance.

witnesses.label: harmful
witnesses.description: Lower safety endpoint for harmful examples: guardrail blocks overlap as much as the marginals permit, leaving the largest shared miss set.

witnesses.label: harmful
witnesses.description: Upper safety endpoint for harmful examples: guardrail misses are separated as much as the marginals permit, minimizing shared misses.

boundedClaim.statement: Given the stated sample and OR rule, the harmful-example block rate is bounded in [90%, 100%]; the corresponding pass-through risk is bounded in [0%, 10%].
